title: Market-priced October Fed hike
rationale: Markets price an October hike ("Dollar Rises...Growing Prospect of October U.S. Rate-Rise"; "Gold falls...rate-hike bets").

title: Continuation of bond-market selloff into October
rationale: Headlines warn of darker October after brutal September and resumed sell‑offs ("A brutal September for bonds..."; "Bond markets resume sell-off").

title: Persistent euro‑area inflation / ECB tightening pressure
rationale: Eurozone inflation hits multiyear highs and policymakers warn ("Inflation in Eurozone’s Biggest Economies Reaches Multiyear Highs"; "ECB ‘cannot wait’...").

title: Early‑October U.S. jobs report
rationale: Markets await payrolls ("10-year Treasury yield is higher as traders look past inflation data, await jobs report").

title: Near‑term U.S. PCE inflation release
rationale: The Fed's main inflation measure is due ("The Fed's main inflation measure will be released Wednesday"); it moves expectations and yields.

title: Worsening junk‑bond stress
rationale: Junk bonds face severe monthly losses, signaling wider credit stress ("Junk bonds are heading for worst month since 2022"; "punishing global selloff").

title: Continued oil price surge
rationale: Oil rises are driving rate bets and tighter oil‑Treasury ties ("Oil price and US Treasury yields in tightest relationship since 1990"; "Oil rises").
